preconditions.description: The number of pillars is between 1 and 10^5.
The absolute difference threshold is between 0 and 10^9.
The height of each pillar is between 1 and 10^15.

postconditions.expression: k == max([len(sequence) for sequence in possible_sequences])
postconditions.description: The output sequence length k is the length of the longest possible jump sequence.

postconditions.expression: all(i_j < i_next for j in range(len(sequence) - 1) for i_next in sequence[j+1:])
postconditions.description: The output sequence is strictly increasing.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(h[i_j] - h[i_next]) >= d for j in range(len(sequence) - 1) for i_next in sequence[j+1:])
postconditions.description: The height difference between consecutive pillars in the sequence is at least d.
